drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our proposed first-pass revision. The draft still needs the Tenant’s legal name, the Base Rent schedule, and a defined Commencement Date. We have also proposed a customary standard for assignment consent. Please send your client’s proposed business terms for the open items so we can turn a clean draft promptly.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Commercial Lease Agreement (this “Lease”) is between Calder Properties (“Landlord”) and [Tenant legal name] (“Tenant”). Landlord and Tenant may be referred to individually as a “Party” and collectively as the “Parties.”

2. RENT. Tenant shall pay monthly Base Rent in the amounts and on the dates set forth in Exhibit A. The Parties shall complete Exhibit A before execution. Rent shall be paid to Landlord at the address or by the method Landlord designates by written notice. Any additional rent or other charges payable by Tenant must be expressly provided for in this Lease.

3. TERM. The term of this Lease is sixty (60) months, commencing on the Commencement Date. “Commencement Date” means [insert agreed date]. The Parties shall confirm the Commencement Date in writing before execution.

4. ASSIGNMENT. Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet all or any part of the premises without Landlord’s prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Landlord shall respond to a written request for consent within a reasonable time after receiving the information reasonably necessary to evaluate the request.
